description: Covers capturing and reusing what a project learns: a lessons-learned record fed from debugging sessions, code review findings, failed and successful research approaches, incidents and near-misses; blameless postmortems for the big ones; retrospectives on a cadence; and routing each lesson into the artifact that prevents its repetition (test, doc, checklist, onboarding note). Use PROACTIVELY when a nontrivial bug is fixed, a review uncovers a recurring pattern, an approach is abandoned, or an incident is resolved - and when the user asks to record a lesson, run a retrospective or postmortem, wants a LESSONS or NOTES file, or asks why the same mistake keeps happening.
